words.example: It is a [myth] that goldfish only remember things for three seconds.
words.exampleZh: 金魚只有三秒記憶是一種迷思。

words.example: The mountain is [visible] from my window on clear days.
words.exampleZh: 天氣晴朗時，從我的窗戶看得到那座山。

words.example: The satellite [orbits] the Earth every 90 minutes.
words.exampleZh: 這顆衛星每 90 分鐘繞地球一圈。

words.example: The [astronaut] took photos of the Earth from space.
words.exampleZh: 太空人從太空拍下地球的照片。

words.example: The street is too [narrow] for buses.
words.exampleZh: 這條街太窄，公車開不進去。

words.example: The [distance] between the two cities is 300 kilometers.
words.exampleZh: 兩座城市相距 300 公里。

words.example: My opinion is [similar] to yours.
words.exampleZh: 我的意見跟你的相似。

words.example: Can you [spot] the difference between these two pictures?
words.exampleZh: 你看得出這兩張圖的差別嗎？

words.example: Please [repeat] the question more slowly.
words.exampleZh: 請再慢一點重複一次問題。

words.example: There is no [evidence] that the story is true.
words.exampleZh: 沒有證據顯示那個故事是真的。

words.example: Make sure your information is [accurate] before you share it.
words.exampleZh: 分享之前先確認你的資訊是正確的。

words.example: It is a [popular] belief, but it is wrong.
words.exampleZh: 這是很普遍的看法，但它是錯的。

words.example: Some websites [claim] that the product works in one day.
words.exampleZh: 有些網站聲稱這個產品一天就見效。

words.example: I [doubt] that he will arrive on time.
words.exampleZh: 我懷疑他會準時到。

words.example: Is this news source [reliable]?
words.exampleZh: 這個新聞來源可靠嗎？

words.example: Many people [take it for granted] that the internet will always work.
words.exampleZh: 很多人把網路永遠能用視為理所當然。

words.example: Scientists wanted to [find out] whether the rumor was true.
words.exampleZh: 科學家想查明傳聞是否屬實。

words.example: Her bright red coat made her [stand out] in the crowd.
words.exampleZh: 她亮紅色的外套讓她在人群中很顯眼。

words.example: The frog's color helps it [blend in with] the leaves.
words.exampleZh: 青蛙的顏色讓牠能和葉子融為一體。

words.example: [At first glance], the two photos look the same.
words.exampleZh: 乍看之下，這兩張照片看起來一樣。
